spring.reason: Press feedback is nonphysical and time-bounded.

pressFeedback.exit: valid press-out commits; invalid release restores
pressFeedback.reduceMotionReplacement: Remove scale; apply immediate fill/border/semantic state.
pressFeedback.lowPowerFallback: Opacity and border only, no scale.

spring.reason: Selection synchronization uses a short timing transition.

selectionSync.enter: selected shape and label update in one commit

durationMs.reason: Spring duration is emergent; tune on representative devices.

bottomSheetSettle.enter: start from live translation and retained grab offset
bottomSheetSettle.reversal: cancel current spring and continue from live shared value
bottomSheetSettle.snapPolicy: Project release 0.18s using position + direction + velocity; velocity may not cross a guarded boundary.
bottomSheetSettle.reduceMotionReplacement: Direct tracking remains; release snaps immediately to nearest valid detent with a 90ms scrim fade.
bottomSheetSettle.lowPowerFallback: No overshoot, nearest-position snap, 120ms opacity only.

scrubFollow.enter: capture thumb and presentation value on gesture begin
scrubFollow.exit: commit coalesced time on valid release
scrubFollow.snapPolicy: Clamp to 19:30–04:30; optional 5-minute keyboard/accessibility steps; no invalid interpolation.
scrubFollow.reduceMotionReplacement: Keep direct tracking; remove large sky/camera travel and update diagram/text immediately.
scrubFollow.lowPowerFallback: Throttle expensive data work to 10 Hz while thumb and time label remain frame-synchronous.

timelineDrag.enter: capture node, route revision, and grab offset
timelineDrag.exit: commit only a valid ordered timeline
timelineDrag.reversal: reverse or re-grab from live value
timelineDrag.snapPolicy: 5-minute grid, ordered-node and safety-return clamps; invalid releases restore candidate.
timelineDrag.reduceMotionReplacement: Direct tracking remains; commit/cancel changes labels without settle travel.
timelineDrag.lowPowerFallback: Update dependent route preview after release; node/time label remain direct.

modeTransition.exit: retain identical task state and geometry
modeTransition.reversal: new mode replaces current target immediately
modeTransition.flashBoundary: No CSS filter; red-light path never introduces blue or bright-white intermediate frames.

asyncStatus.exit: replace with success/error without layout jump
asyncStatus.reversal: latest request result wins only when correlation/revision matches
asyncStatus.lowPowerFallback: No animated progress; show determinate text percentage or indeterminate label.

selection.android: CLOCK_TICK or product wrapper selection fallback
selection.semanticIntent: discrete user-driven selection or approved snap
selection.trigger: after a valid selected value/detent changes, never on every drag frame

warning.android: REJECT or wrapper warning where supported
warning.trigger: when impact disclosure becomes actionable, not on page entry
suppression: screen reader action already repeated within 800ms

impact.semanticIntent: physical detent or hard valid boundary
impact.trigger: approved sheet detent or hard-clamped node boundary

component.stateOwner: mobile-shell-and-preferences screen model owns domain state; the component owns only transient presentation state.
component.sourceOfTruth: Shared decision context or owning Outcome reducer/query cache; server/provider facts remain backend authority.

emittedEvents.name: primary_tab_bar_event
emittedEvents.when: On valid commit, explicit cancel, or terminal async result; continuous gestures emit throttled presentation updates separately.
emittedEvents.duplicatePrevention: operationId/sourceRevision; coalesce continuous updates and suppress repeated terminal announcements.

crossSurfaceEffects: Remain within owning Outcome; emit an explicit event for any shared-context mutation rather than mutating another surface directly.

asynchronousBoundaries.reason: No async commit is required for the local interaction; upstream async state still arrives as controlled props.

visual.safeAreaRelation: Page assembly owns outer safe area; local target never extends under a system gesture edge without hit arbitration.

responsiveRules: 390×844 is the baseline.
At 360/430 width, use full available inline size with no horizontal page scroll.
At tablet/landscape, keep content measure and do not stretch compact actions beyond their semantic group.
visual.orientationRules: Portrait is primary; landscape may use split content but preserves reading/focus order and all actions.
visual.textScaleRules: At 200% text scale, labels wrap, content height grows, two-column specimens collapse to one column, and key actions/units are never clipped or ellipsized.

preconditions: Required permission and safety gates are represented before commit.

interactionStateMachine.validation: Bounds, permissions, safety conditions, input schema, source revision, and duplicate-operation rules are checked before commit.
sideEffects: Remain within owning Outcome; emit an explicit event for any shared-context mutation rather than mutating another surface directly.
interactionStateMachine.cancel: Press/gesture cancel and confirmation cancel do not mutate domain state and return focus to the logical trigger.
interactionStateMachine.interruption: Direct manipulation is interruptible; async work is cancelable or superseded by correlation/revision.
interactionStateMachine.reversal: Valid pre-commit cancellation restores the last committed value.
interactionStateMachine.retry: Retry retains input, increments attempt metadata, and uses a new request id while deduplicating the logical operation.
interactionStateMachine.offline: Explicitly block or use owning fallback; never fabricate fresh data.

interactionStateMachine.idempotency: operationId + sourceRevision; non-idempotent actions disable duplicate commit until terminal state.

sideEffects: Remain within owning Outcome; emit an explicit event for any shared-context mutation rather than mutating another surface directly.
interactionStateMachine.cancel: Press/gesture cancel and confirmation cancel do not mutate domain state and return focus to the logical trigger.

sideEffects: Remain within owning Outcome; emit an explicit event for any shared-context mutation rather than mutating another surface directly.
interactionStateMachine.cancel: Press/gesture cancel and confirmation cancel do not mutate domain state and return focus to the logical trigger.
interactionStateMachine.interruption: Direct manipulation is interruptible; async work is cancelable or superseded by correlation/revision.

interactionStateMachine.retry: Retry retains input, increments attempt metadata, and uses a new request id while deduplicating the logical operation.

interactionStateMachine.error: 失败层被移除并标注，基础轨迹继续可用。
interactionStateMachine.recovery: Restore last valid state, retry/change context, and announce recovery without duplicate events.
interactionStateMachine.idempotency: operationId + sourceRevision; non-idempotent actions disable duplicate commit until terminal state.

preconditions: Required permission and safety gates are represented before commit.

interactionStateMachine.validation: Bounds, permissions, safety conditions, input schema, source revision, and duplicate-operation rules are checked before commit.
sideEffects: Remain within owning Outcome; emit an explicit event for any shared-context mutation rather than mutating another surface directly.
interactionStateMachine.cancel: Press/gesture cancel and confirmation cancel do not mutate domain state and return focus to the logical trigger.
interactionStateMachine.interruption: Direct manipulation is interruptible; async work is cancelable or superseded by correlation/revision.
interactionStateMachine.reversal: Valid pre-commit cancellation restores the last committed value.
interactionStateMachine.retry: Retry retains input, increments attempt metadata, and uses a new request id while deduplicating the logical operation.
interactionStateMachine.offline: Explicitly block or use owning fallback; never fabricate fresh data.
interactionStateMachine.conflict: Revision mismatch rejects stale response and requests refresh.
interactionStateMachine.error: 本地草稿保留并可重试，不覆盖已保存版本。
interactionStateMachine.recovery: Restore last valid state, retry/change context, and announce recovery without duplicate events.
interactionStateMachine.idempotency: operationId + sourceRevision; non-idempotent actions disable duplicate commit until terminal state.

interactionStateMachine.trigger: 点击“一键分享当前地点”。
preconditions: Required permission and safety gates are represented before commit.
interactionStateMachine.output: 用户预览确认后打开目标通道，并只在收到系统结果时描述为已发起/已送达（若可证）。
interactionStateMachine.validation: Bounds, permissions, safety conditions, input schema, source revision, and duplicate-operation rules are checked before commit.
sideEffects: Remain within owning Outcome; emit an explicit event for any shared-context mutation rather than mutating another surface directly.
interactionStateMachine.cancel: Press/gesture cancel and confirmation cancel do not mutate domain state and return focus to the logical trigger.
interactionStateMachine.interruption: Direct manipulation is interruptible; async work is cancelable or superseded by correlation/revision.
interactionStateMachine.reversal: Candidate can reverse before commit; post-commit reversal uses an explicit revision/undo/revoke transition.
interactionStateMachine.retry: Retry retains input, increments attempt metadata, and uses a new request id while deduplicating the logical operation.
interactionStateMachine.offline: Explicitly block or use owning fallback; never fabricate fresh data.
interactionStateMachine.conflict: Revision mismatch rejects stale response and requests refresh.
interactionStateMachine.error: 明确未发送或状态未知，载荷可重试但不自动外发。
interactionStateMachine.recovery: Restore last valid state, retry/change context, and announce recovery without duplicate events.
interactionStateMachine.idempotency: operationId + sourceRevision; non-idempotent actions disable duplicate commit until terminal state.

dangerousOrPrivacyAction.impactDisclosure: 明确未发送或状态未知，载荷可重试但不自动外发。

dangerousOrPrivacyAction.auditAndRecovery: Record privacy-safe operation/audit id; expose undo/revoke/restore when the owning service supports it.
dangerousOrPrivacyAction.irreversibleBoundary: Reversible or revocable where owning service allows; otherwise state the exact boundary.
dangerousOrPrivacyAction.cancellation: Cancel before commit changes no domain state; interrupted confirmation closes safely and returns focus.

interactionStateMachine.trigger: 点击评价或行程结束提醒。
preconditions: Required permission and safety gates are represented before commit.

sideEffects: Remain within owning Outcome; emit an explicit event for any shared-context mutation rather than mutating another surface directly.

interactionStateMachine.idempotency: operationId + sourceRevision; non-idempotent actions disable duplicate commit until terminal state.

interactionStateMachine.recovery: Restore last valid state, retry/change context, and announce recovery without duplicate events.
interactionStateMachine.idempotency: operationId + sourceRevision; non-idempotent actions disable duplicate commit until terminal state.

platformAndSystem.iOS: Use native Pressable/navigation/accessibility behavior and supported semantic Taptic feedback.

platformAndSystem.deepLink: Route /me restores owning context first; unavailable entity/revision uses an honest not-found/stale recovery state.
platformAndSystem.keyboardDismissal: Submit or explicit dismiss; sheet resize follows keyboard without hiding focused field/action; focus returns predictably.

sensorUnavailableDegraded.reason: No sensor/camera capability is required by this control.

safetyCopy.reason: No safety/privacy impact disclosure is owned.

translationExpansion.layoutResponse: grow/reflow; never shrink below declared type token or 44px target

contentLocalization.pluralization: Use Intl.PluralRules/message catalog for counts; no string concatenation assumptions.

localeFormatting.timeZone: IANA zone displayed when ambiguity matters
localeFormatting.units: metric default with locale/user preference conversion at formatting boundary

displayedData.meaning: 帮助目录、政策版本、数据源/许可、构建/runtime、诊断同意和反馈内容。
displayedData.source: Owning identity-profile-privacy query/reducer; UI does not redefine backend/provider authority.
displayedData.freshness: Generated/observed/expired timestamp and source revision stay adjacent to decision evidence where relevant.
displayedData.latency: Immediate shell/pressed feedback; reserve layout; after 15s expose cancel/retry/limited path rather than indefinite spinner.

dataPrivacySafety.loadingPolicy: 关键安全帮助/政策缓存，网络内容显示状态。
dataPrivacySafety.offline: If unavailable offline, retain input and show explicit offline block/alternative.
dataPrivacySafety.cache: Cache identity includes context, source version, and generated/expires timestamps; stale is never relabeled fresh.
dataPrivacySafety.conflict: Reject stale async completion using sourceRevision.
dataPrivacySafety.concurrency: Latest compatible revision may render; in-flight work is cancelable/superseded; non-idempotent duplicate commit is blocked.

sensitiveData.masking: Mask precise location/account/session identifiers in review, logs, notifications, and telemetry.
sensitiveData.retention: UI displays user-facing retention/expiry from owning policy; this candidate does not define backend retention.

dataPrivacySafety.privacySafetyBoundary: UI explains and guards the user action; authoritative authorization, data deletion, route safety, provider truth, and retention remain backend/system responsibilities.

icon.reuseLicenseStatus: Project-internal candidate asset; no third-party dependency
icon.tintModeBehavior: Uses foreground/action token of planning, night, or red-light mode.

illustrationMedia.reason: No illustration or media asset is required.

unicodeProductionIcon.reason: Production-intent icons are self-contained SVG symbols; any textual arrow/plus in explanatory copy is not registered as an icon.

analyticsTelemetry.intent: Measure whether help-and-source-center helps the declared task and where recovery is needed, without collecting content.
analyticsTelemetry.duplicateEventPrevention: One terminal result per logical operationId; continuous drag/scrub frames are not analytics events.

observabilityPerformance.perceivedLatency: Pressed feedback <=80ms; preserve shell/context; determinate progress where measurable; after 15s show cancel/retry/limited path.

largeDataMapDensity.reason: Expected local collection is bounded and small.

observabilityPerformance.frameAndPowerConstraints: Target 60fps on supported devices; gesture-linked work stays on UI thread; low-power removes nonessential animation/overshoot and reduces expensive update cadence; reduced motion replacement is mandatory.

field-dashboard.sourceInteraction: 单手查看当前地点、剩余窗口、返程与安全状态。

night-red-mode-toggle.sourceInteraction: 在规划 / 夜间 / 红光间切换；信息架构与位置不变。

field-tool-grid.sourceInteraction: 打开计时、水平仪、手电提示与摄影计划工具。

return-to-parking.sourceInteraction: 显示返车方向、距离与离线路线；不提供安全保证。

backup-switcher.sourceInteraction: 因云量或风险切换主备地点并同步行程 revision。

safety-session-panel.sourceInteraction: 设置返程提醒与失联升级；危险停止需二次确认。

location-share-action.sourceInteraction: 确认范围与时限后生成本地样例分享状态，不真实发送。

offline-sync-queue.sourceInteraction: 查看待同步条目、重试与冲突；三次失败后显示错误 ID。

new-spot-wizard.sourceInteraction: 分步提交候选地点坐标、到达与证据；草稿保留。

field-report-form.sourceInteraction: 提交云量、能见度、风与现场风险的时效实况。

multidimensional-review-form.sourceInteraction: 按黑暗度、视野、到达、安全与设施评价。

correction-report.sourceInteraction: 选择待纠错事实、填写依据并保存草稿。

media-privacy-review.sourceInteraction: 确认人脸、车牌、定位与拍摄时间披露范围。

contribution-status-center.sourceInteraction: 查看草稿、审核中、需补充与已采纳状态。

notification-rule-editor.sourceInteraction: 编辑云量、透明度、地点与提前量规则；权限拒绝后保留规则。

notification-settings-center.sourceInteraction: 管理系统权限、静默时段、频率与渠道说明。

notification-message-deeplink.sourceInteraction: 打开样例通知并跳转到对应地点 / 夜晚上下文。

toolbox-index.sourceInteraction: 打开天象、月相、视场与曝光工具。

celestial-event-detail.sourceInteraction: 查看英仙座流星雨样例窗口、方向与来源。

astronomy-calculator-form.sourceInteraction: 输入焦距、传感器与赤纬，计算样例视场 / 最长曝光。

auth-gate-sheet.sourceInteraction: 选择继续游客模式或打开本地登录样例；不进行真实认证。

guest-data-merge.sourceInteraction: 预览游客数据合并范围与冲突，再二次确认。

profile-hub.sourceInteraction: 查看个人摘要、偏好、贡献与同步状态。

content-library-browser.sourceInteraction: 筛选已存地点、行程、摄影计划与离线包。

equipment-manager.sourceInteraction: 添加、编辑或移除相机、镜头、望远镜与三脚架样例。

session-security.sourceInteraction: 查看本机样例会话、撤销设备需二次确认。

privacy-center.sourceInteraction: 设置精确位置、历史保留、贡献署名与诊断数据。

export-delete-flow.sourceInteraction: 导出样例数据或经影响说明与二次确认进入删除流程。

help-and-source-center.sourceInteraction: 查看术语、数据来源、许可、版本与已知限制。

traceability.immutableInputRule: All frozen paths were read only; no upstream file is an output target.

runtimeRepair.rootCause: v2 initialized flowKey as map-sync although FLOW_DEFS only defines A–F, then called the coarse renderFlow before the enhanced flow layer and complete handlers were installed; FLOW_DEFS[flowKey] was undefined and label access terminated the remaining script.
runtimeRepair.fix: Initialize with A, defer the first flow render until enhanced renderFlow/flowApply and all handlers exist, reset branches before select changes, and expose defensive UNKNOWN_FLOW, EMPTY_PATH, STEP_OUT_OF_RANGE, INVALID_STEP, UNKNOWN_CONTROL, and MISSING_SPECIMEN states.
